title: Chapter 3 Building A Territory
content:
Chapter 3 Building A Territory

Exchange, you can exchange talents, soldiers and horses, then fight for territory, then exchange, fight for territory, then ascend the throne as king, rule the world, and finally the whole world is conquered by yourself, and there are three thousand beauties in the harem, no shame Shameless life.

Zhong Yu listened to the host's explanation, digested it in his heart, and after regaining his senses, he immediately opened the mouth and said:

"System, open the task options!"

"Mission options turned on!"

After a mechanized sound came, a blue screen appeared in front of Zhong Yu's eyes. It was full of high-tech feeling, and various words and data appeared. Zhong Yu looked at it.

Main quest: Build power and grow stronger.

The first stage of the task: establish a territory of your own, and let your own influence be initially built in this world. (Note: The novice comes with a lord's mansion, please find a suitable place to lay it out!)

Reward: a primary lucky draw package

Side quests: none

It turns out that this is the case. It seems that this task system is quite useful. As long as you find a place and lay out the lord's mansion, you can get a lottery gift package. It is quite simple!

"System, continue to open the exchange option!"

The Blu-ray changed for a while, and then the content that appeared on it changed again!

Exchange area:

Character exchange:

First-order talents: the price is a little bit luckier

Second-order talents: 10 points of price luck

Tier 3 talents: 50 points of price luck

Fourth-tier talents: The price is one thousand—?

Fifth-order talents: The price is 10,000——?

Soldier exchange, the price is halved according to the character exchange price!

Zhong Yu looked at the data with anticipation, and asked the system: "System, what do the first-order and second-order levels mean there, is there any supernatural power in this world? Also, why are the soldiers the same Level, but the exchange price is half of the talent?"

Thinking that if there is supernatural power in this world, then it is really dangerous. With its own strength, it may be destroyed at any time. If nothing else, it was the wolf just now. If it was a legendary beast or a monster, would he really still be alive? I shivered thinking about it.

The system heard Zhong Yu's question, and slowly answered him: "The power in this world is divided into non-flow and 1 to 5 levels, non-flow means that you have not undergone any training, or have mastered some basic fighting skills, But at most it is an enemy of several people, and there is not much threat."

"As for the first-order, you have mastered terrifying killing skills through strict training, and you can match dozens of people, but you are still an ordinary ant, and there is not much difference between ordinary people!"

"The second level is to practice a certain exercise and master some supernatural power, such as fighting qi magic, martial arts internal strength, you can use it to bless your body, gain greater power, and can match dozens of people; the third level is, Those who are proficient in exercises or some kind of supernatural power can control them in a more subtle way. They can control their own power more thoroughly, and can rival hundreds of people. At this stage, the transformation and sublimation of human life begins. There is such a slight possibility of becoming a god and sanctifying!"

"The fourth level is to comprehend a certain will. When attacking, you can bring that will and bless it in your own moves. Your own moves and moves can deter the enemy. Those who do not understand the will, or the will that comprehends are not as good as Your own people will be weakened. As for the fifth stage, it is to evolve the will into a domain. In the domain, that kind of person is a god. That kind of existence can no longer be described by language, even on this continent, there is no such thing as Several people have reached the fifth level."

"As for the halving of the exchange price of soldiers, that is because the soldiers have no special abilities, and their strength has just barely reached that level, which is the bottom, and they are not even close to that level of strength, so the price is halved!"

So soldiers have no human rights! He complained about the system in his heart, and then he thought about the high ups and downs he fantasized about when he was a child, flying over the eaves and walls, helping the poor, the knights who are happy and revengeful, flying to the ground, overturning the rivers and overturning the seas, flying through the clouds and driving the fog, immortal immortals , Now it's not a dream anymore, and I have the opportunity to become that kind of existence.

After briefly explaining the division of the power system and giving the host some time to understand, the system interrupted Zhong Yu's fantasy and continued:

"Now ask the host to determine the location of the lord's mansion, establish his first territory, start his lord career, and take the first step in his journey to conquer another world!"

Although some people don't like the system interrupting their fantasies directly, it's still too early to think about it. Zhong Yu thinks of his own incompetent strength and the reality that anyone can kill him.

I can't help but swear to work harder, I must become that kind of high-level existence, but now I have to determine the location of the city, then build my own territory, increase my population, train my army, and get enough luck points, To be able to fulfill their wishes!

Looking down from the cliff, it is a continuous, ups and downs of forests and mountains, and the surrounding is an endless plain. There are faint fireworks floating in a dozen places in the plain, and it seems that someone lives there. .

But Zhong Yu didn't dare to run over there. The people who can survive in such a harsh environment are either savages or cannibals, anyway, they are a group of uncivilized human beings without civilization. They roasted and ate it as food, how wronged they were.

On the cliff, I carefully looked at which place is the best place to build a city. After thinking about it for a while, I set a goal and ran down the cliff quickly. Zhong Yu desperately wanted to find a place, open the base of the lord's mansion, and start myself. lordship.

I stumbled all the way, and carefully avoided many dangers. Several times, I was almost discovered by ferocious beasts and savages, and avoided the past.

Finally, Zhong Yu came to the site that he had chosen to build the city on the cliff. The place is surrounded by rivers on three sides, and only one side faces the plain. It is a good place that is easy to defend and difficult to attack. He also recognizes that the fishery is rich and the land is irrigated by rivers and is very fertile. , can provide sufficient food, with enough food, you can raise more population, enough population, you can provide more soldiers, with more soldiers, then the territory can be expanded.

When I came to the center of the river, I chose a spot and said to the system: "Lay the main city base!"

"Received the order to lay the main city base. The laying is in progress. The laying is completed. Please name the territory for the host!" The sound of the system's mechanization came.

The name of the territory, since it is the name of the territory, I can travel through it, and it is completely playing the game of the Three Kingdoms, and the Three Kingdoms is an adaptation of the history of the Three Kingdoms period. The famous capitals in the early period of the Three Kingdoms were Xuchang and Luoyang.

Xuchang has too little history, while Luoyang's history is deep enough and has been passed down for thousands of years, so let's call it Luoyang!

"System, the name of this territory is Luoyang, Luoyang City, which indicates that a great empire will rise and revitalize in my hands!"

As soon as the voice fell, I saw the plain in front of Zhong Yu's eyes, and a light appeared, which I couldn't look directly at. A set of phantoms of a very huge mansion slowly appeared in the light, and it was quickly enriched, and slowly became a set of phantoms. Really architectural image.

The mansion slowly appeared in front of you, and looking around, it looked like a standard county government office in ancient times.

Enter the mansion, go through several corridors, and come to a courtyard. Follow the road straight to the lobby between the courtyards. On the way, there is a stone lighthouse, each with five steps. , full of greenery, a very elegant place.

Walking into the lobby, I saw that although there are not many decorations in the hall, it is just right, the space is wide, and the decorations are mostly black, with some red in them, which looks heavy, just to decorate the majesty of the lord.

Zhong Yu was shocked to see the majestic and beautiful lord's mansion in front of him, and his heart was shocked, and at the same time, a feeling of joy flooded into his heart. All of this will belong to me from now on. I didn't expect that I could also live there. A place more luxurious than the so-called mansion in the previous life.

Recalling that before, I lived in that cramped dog kennel, and there was an unpredictable world in my heart, and complex emotions were brewing in my heart.
